notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing both Treasure tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Black Market Tycoon by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
